caption: A lamp beside a dark window is switched on at night, and the reflection of the lamp and the room appears in the glass.

sa.check: A lamp stands beside a dark window at night.
The reflection of the lamp and the room appears in the glass.
The lamp comes on first and the reflection appears with it.

pc.expect: The reflection appears with the lamp and would fade if the lamp were turned off.
pc.fail: The reflection is there with the lamp off; or the lamp comes on and no reflection appears; or the reflection remains after the lamp goes off.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image of the lamp and room, at the same height across the glass.
pc.fail: It is a different room; or upside down; or a rotated copy rather than mirrored.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It slides across the glass; or shifts while the room is still.

pc.expect: The glass is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: The glass ripples; or the reflection warps; or the window bends.

pc.expect: One lamp and one reflection; the reflection stays in the glass.
pc.fail: A second lamp appears in the room; or the reflection comes out of the glass; or the lamp vanishes; or the lamp passes into the window.

pc.expect: The lamp, the room and the window frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The lamp changes colour; or the frame changes; or the room rearranges.
